title: Educational Approaches That Enhance Online Clinical Clerkship during the COVID-19 Pandemic
reason: National cross-sectional survey of medical students: self-reported exposure to online clerkship approaches (quiz, assignment, etc.) related by mixed models to self-reported satisfaction, motivation and knowledge/skill acquisition. All data self-report; no platform records.

extraction.n_quote: Finally, 1,671 responses were used for the analysis of this study.
extraction.lms_indicators: none (self-reported frequency of quizzes, assignment submission, etc.)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: self-reported satisfaction, motivation, knowledge and skill acquisition, self-study time
extraction.notes: Abstract says 1,711 matched inclusion criteria; the text and Table 2 give 1,671 analysed.
